title: DW-MT325-PromotionGate
group: DW Durable workspace volumes and handoff
clause: Promotion = re-hash blobs against manifest + git bundle verify against the authoritative repo + declared validation checks; only a passing gate appends the PROMOTED EventLedger event that makes digests authority-reachable; failures produce durable typed denial evidence and fail closed

scope.summary:
GOAL: Build the single gate through which agent work becomes authority-reachable. A pending bundle (MT-324) is promoted only after three independent verifications pass: (1) INTEGRITY - re-hash every blob against the manifest's declared digests via the CAS verified-read path (P12: integrity verification on read is the CAS contract; the gate re-reads FULLY, never trusts prior writes); (2) PREREQUISITE - `git bundle verify` of the patch payload against the authoritative repository proves the recorded prerequisite base SHA exists there (P13: bundle verify is git's built-in promotion precondition check); (3) DECLARED CHECKS - the typed validation checks declared for the bundle (registered validator commands, e.g. a build or test subset) all pass. Only a fully passing gate appends the PROMOTED event to the EventLedger - the event that makes the bundle's digests reachable from authority state and therefore visible to MT-326's GC mark phase and to downstream merge-back tooling. Every failure fails CLOSED and produces durable typed denial evidence (PROMOTION_DENIED event + denial row): a denial an operator can inspect is recoverable; a silent partial promotion is corruption.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: workspace_volumes/promotion_gate.rs (gate orchestration, check runner, denial evidence types); one migration 03NN_promotion_checks.surql (declared-check registry + denial evidence); tests. No protocol changes, no adapter changes, no GUI.

DETAILED SPEC:
1. Gate API (promotion_gate.rs):
   pub struct PromotionGate { pool: SurrealDbClient, access: ResourceAccessContext, cas: HostCasStore, authoritative_repo_root: PathBuf }
   pub async fn promote_bundle(&self, export_id: Uuid) -> Result<PromotionRecord, PromotionDenied>
   pub struct PromotionRecord { pub export_id: Uuid, pub manifest_digest: Sha256Digest, pub promoted_event_id: i64, pub checks_passed: Vec<CheckOutcome> }
   pub struct PromotionDenied { pub export_id: Uuid, pub denial_event_id: i64, pub failed_step: PromotionStep, pub evidence: DenialEvidence }
   pub enum PromotionStep { ManifestLoad, BlobIntegrity, BundleVerify, DeclaredCheck { check_id: String }, StateTransition }
   pub struct DenialEvidence { pub expected: String, pub observed: String, pub command: Option<String>, pub output_digest: Option<Sha256Digest> }  // full command output goes into CAS as a blob; evidence rows reference it by digest so denial evidence is itself content-addressed and tamper-evident
2. Gate sequence (strictly ordered, short-circuit on first failure):
   step 1 ManifestLoad: load the manifest blob via open_verified (a corrupt manifest is itself a denial, not an exception path); parse; assert schema_id hsk.workspace_bundle_manifest@1; assert export_bundles row state == 'pending_promotion' with FOR UPDATE row lock held for the whole gate run (concurrent promote calls serialize; second caller observes final state and returns idempotently).
   step 2 BlobIntegrity: for every manifest entry, full open_verified read; any IntegrityViolation or missing blob => denial with expected/observed digests.
   step 3 BundleVerify: if a Patch entry exists: materialize the bundle blob to a temp file under the runtime root and run `git -C <authoritative_repo_root> -c core.longpaths=true bundle verify <tmp_path>` (the -c core.longpaths=true discipline matches MT-141's Windows rule and the WP's established git invocation shape); non-zero exit => denial with stderr captured to CAS. The prerequisite SHA in the manifest must also equal a real commit in the authoritative repo (`git cat-file -e <sha>^{commit}`); mismatch => denial. NOTE: verify only - this gate NEVER fetches, applies, merges, or pushes; applying promoted patches is downstream WM-family/merge-back territory.
   step 4 DeclaredCheck: checks come from the promotion_checks registry (see 3); each check runs as a command in a scratch working dir with the scoped CARGO_TARGET_DIR from ../Handshake_Artifacts/ (house rule), a wall-clock timeout, captured output CAS-blobbed; any non-zero exit or timeout => denial naming the check_id. Checks never run guest-supplied executables: commands are host-registered templates (check_id -> argv template) that may only reference bundle content as DATA inputs.
   step 5 StateTransition: one SurrealDB transaction: export_bundles.bundle_state 'pending_promotion' -> 'promoted' (guarded UPDATE ... WHERE bundle_state = 'pending_promotion') + PROMOTED EventLedger append { export_id, manifest_digest, subject digests, checks_passed, gate_version }. If the guarded update matches zero rows, the gate lost a race - re-read and return the observed terminal state idempotently. Denial path mirrors it: 'pending_promotion' -> 'denied' + PROMOTION_DENIED append + denial row, also one transaction, also guarded.
3. Declared-check registry, migration 03NN_promotion_checks.surql:
   SCHEMAFULL semantic field inventory for promotion_checks (
       check_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (check_id ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}$'),
       argv_template typed SurrealDB object NOT NULL,
       timeout_ms BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (timeout_ms > 0),
       enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
       owner_account_id UUID NOT NULL, actor_principal_id UUID NOT NULL, authenticated_session_id UUID NOT NULL, access_space_id UUID NOT NULL, workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
       created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
   );
   SCHEMAFULL semantic field inventory for promotion_denials (
       denial_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
       export_id UUID NOT NULL,
       failed_step TEXT NOT NULL,
       expected TEXT NOT NULL,
       observed TEXT NOT NULL,
       output_blob_digest TEXT CHECK (output_blob_digest IS NULL OR output_blob_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
       denial_event_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
       owner_account_id UUID NOT NULL, actor_principal_id UUID NOT NULL, authenticated_session_id UUID NOT NULL, access_space_id UUID NOT NULL, workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
       created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
   ); both protected by authenticated record-user PERMISSIONS and ResourceBroker exact-scope enforcement.
4. Fail-closed doctrine: ANY unexpected error inside the gate (IO, SurrealDB query/transaction, parse, timeout, panic-adjacent) resolves to denial or to unchanged 'pending_promotion' - never to 'promoted'. There is exactly one line of code that can write 'promoted' and exactly one that appends PROMOTED, both inside the step-5 transaction; a module-boundary test plus grep proof enforce that no other module references the PROMOTED append path (this pairs with MT-324's EXPORT_NEVER_PROMOTES proof).
5. RESOURCE PRIVACY NOTE: gate reads/writes are scope-filtered via authenticated record-user SurrealQL permissions plus ResourceBroker exact-scope authorization (resource_scope.rs ~798); promotion and denial rows/events inherit the bundle's derived intersection scope (derive_from_sources ~193-228, refusal-not-widening per HBR-PRIV-004); account A can neither promote nor read denials of account B's bundles - both directions live-tested.

STEP-BY-STEP:
1. Read MT-324's export_bundle.rs manifest/state machine, MT-321's CAS API, and the EventLedger append API on post-merge main; confirm the authoritative-repo-root resolution used by governed runs.
2. Implement gate types + the five-step ordered pipeline with FOR UPDATE serialization and guarded state transitions.
3. Implement the check runner (argv templates, timeout, output-to-CAS) with the scoped CARGO_TARGET_DIR environment.
4. Migration 03NN_promotion_checks.surql against real SurrealDB; seed one real default check (e.g. patch-applies-cleanly dry-run: `git apply --check` on a bundle-extracted diff in a scratch clone - still non-mutating).
5. Tests: happy-path promotion (real SurrealDB + real CAS + real git repo with a real bundle); each step's denial (corrupt manifest, corrupt blob, missing prerequisite SHA, failing declared check, transition race) produces typed denial evidence + PROMOTION_DENIED event and leaves state 'denied'; idempotent re-promotion; concurrency race yields one PROMOTED event total; cross-account denial.
6. Run proof targets under scoped CARGO_TARGET_DIR; record measured output.
forbidden_paths: Any patch APPLY/merge/push path (verify-only gate; applying promoted work is downstream merge-back scope)
session_worktrees/** and any repo worktree path (gate scratch space lives under the runtime root / ../Handshake_Artifacts/)
acceptance_criteria: AC-325-1: promote_bundle runs the five steps strictly ordered with short-circuit denial; a live happy-path test against real SurrealDB, real CAS blobs, and a real git repository (real bundle, real prerequisite SHA) yields 'promoted' state + one PROMOTED EventLedger event (Spec-Realism Gate satisfied; fixture-only proof insufficient).

AC-325-2: Blob integrity is proven by full verified re-reads at gate time; a corrupted-after-export blob yields BlobIntegrity denial with expected/observed digests - prior write-time verification is never trusted as gate evidence.

AC-325-3: git bundle verify runs against the authoritative repo with -c core.longpaths=true; a bundle whose prerequisite SHA is absent from the repo yields BundleVerify denial with CAS-blobbed command output; the gate performs no fetch/apply/merge/push (grep proof over the gate module).

AC-325-4: Declared checks execute from host-registered argv templates only, under timeout, with output CAS-blobbed; a failing and a timing-out check each yield DeclaredCheck denial naming the check_id; guest-supplied bytes are never executed.
AC-325-5: State transitions are guarded single-transaction flips; a concurrent double-promote race produces exactly one PROMOTED event and the loser returns idempotently (live concurrency test).

AC-325-6: Every denial writes a promotion_denials row + PROMOTION_DENIED event in one transaction and leaves bundle_state 'denied'; denial evidence is content-addressed (output digests resolvable in CAS).
AC-325-7: Exactly one code path can write 'promoted'/append PROMOTED (module-boundary test + grep proof); unexpected internal errors never resolve to 'promoted' (fault-injection test per step).
AC-325-8: Cross-account promotion attempts and denial-evidence reads are refused (live two-account test); promotion/denial records carry the bundle's derived intersection scope.
AC-325-9: No SQLite, no Docker/containerd deps, no --force, disk-agnostic space-free paths; check runner uses the scoped CARGO_TARGET_DIR under ../Handshake_Artifacts/.
AC-325-10: Proof commands run under the scoped CARGO_TARGET_DIR; measured output recorded; implementer never marks COMPLETED.
code_surfaces: src/backend/handshake_core/src/workspace_volumes/export_bundle.rs (MT-324 state machine; 'promoted' writable only from the gate)
src/backend/handshake_core/src/workspace_volumes/cas.rs (open_verified as the only read path the gate uses)
src/backend/handshake_core/src/swarm_orchestration/resource_scope.rs (authorization semantics translated by MT-338, derive_from_sources ~193-228; lands on main after WP-1 merges)
expected_tests: happy path: real repo + real bundle + real SurrealDB promotion with PROMOTED event
denial per step: corrupt manifest, corrupt blob, missing blob, absent prerequisite SHA, failing check, timeout check
concurrency: two simultaneous promote_bundle calls -> exactly one PROMOTED event, idempotent loser
idempotency: promote on 'promoted' and on 'denied' returns terminal state without new events
fault injection: injected IO/SurrealDB transaction error at each step never yields 'promoted'
security: template-only check execution; a manifest attempting to smuggle an executable path into a check is inert
SurrealDB test: two-account isolation on promote and on denial reads
implementation_notes: Field basis: P13 (git bundle verify as the built-in promotion precondition; prerequisite SHA recorded at export), P12 (CAS integrity-verified reads re-run at gate time; Bazel action-cache analogy for pointer rows), P14 (promotion/denial events as the attestation trail; EventLedger append-only in place of DSSE), P11 (manifest digest as the bundle identity being promoted).

The gate is the authority boundary MT-326 depends on: 'authority-reachable' is DEFINED as 'digest appears in a PROMOTED EventLedger event'; keep that definition in one queryable place (a SurrealDB derived reachability query or one function) because the GC mark phase must use the identical definition.
Verify-only discipline: no fetch/apply/merge/push anywhere in the gate; the WM merge-back family consumes promoted bundles later. This boundary is a grep proof target, not a convention.
Spec-Realism Gate: happy path and bundle-verify denials must use a real git repository and real SurrealDB; declared-check tests must run at least one real subprocess check.

House rules: all Rust; SurrealDB/EventLedger authority, no SQLite; no Docker/containerd/K8s deps; scoped CARGO_TARGET_DIR under ../Handshake_Artifacts/ for the check runner and all proofs; no --force; implementer never marks COMPLETED.
Resource privacy: gate operations are scope-filtered both at SQL and after deserialization; promotion never widens the bundle's derived scope.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend gate MT; promotion states and denial evidence surface to the operator in MT-327. Every gate decision is a durable EventLedger event plus typed SurrealDB rows.

target_entries: Workspace handoff > Promotion gate (the three verifications, what PROMOTED means, why the gate never applies patches)
Workspace handoff > Denial evidence (reading promotion_denials, resolving CAS-blobbed command output, retry semantics)

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.note: PROMOTED/PROMOTION_DENIED are EventLedger events in this MT; the FR timeline kinds for the operator surface are added centrally in MT-327. Record DEFERRED-to-MT-327.
Emit diagnostic events on gate denial and on gate-internal unexpected errors via the open diagnostic-event API if present; otherwise DEFERRED-with-reason.
The gate is a bounded host-side pipeline with per-step durable outcomes; a crashed gate leaves 'pending_promotion' unchanged and is simply re-run - liveness capture adds no evidence.

risk_if_missed: Either nothing ever becomes authority-reachable (handoff dead-ends at pending bundles) or - worse - ad-hoc promotion appears without integrity re-verification and prerequisite checks, letting corrupt or wrong-base work into authority state and giving MT-326's GC a poisoned reachability definition that could both keep garbage forever and expose good work to collection.

risks: RISK-1: A race or crash between the state flip and the PROMOTED append leaves the row and the ledger disagreeing about reachability - the GC mark phase then operates on a lie.
RISK-2: A manifest or check definition smuggles guest-controlled bytes into subprocess execution (command injection through argv templates or path fields).
RISK-3: The gate 'promotes' on cached write-time verification without re-reading blobs, missing corruption that occurred between export and promotion.
RISK-4: Denial evidence is prose-only and mutable, so a denied bundle cannot be audited later and disputed denials are unresolvable.
RISK-5: A second promotion surface appears (convenience function, test helper leaking into prod paths) that bypasses one or more gate steps.
minimum_controls: CTRL-1 (RISK-1): row flip and ledger append share one transaction with a guarded UPDATE; race test proves single-event outcome; a reconciliation query (state vs ledger) ships as a named test helper for MT-326 to reuse.
CTRL-2 (RISK-2): checks are host-registered argv templates; bundle content enters only as data file paths validated against the scratch root; injection attempt test is a named regression.
CTRL-3 (RISK-3): gate-time full open_verified re-reads are asserted by the corrupted-after-export test; no code path passes write-time results to the gate.
CTRL-4 (RISK-4): denial evidence rows reference CAS-blobbed command output by digest; evidence is content-addressed and tamper-evident; resolvability live-tested.
CTRL-5 (RISK-5): single-writer discipline enforced by module boundary + grep proofs on both MT-324 (never promotes) and this MT (only the step-5 transaction promotes).

Verified current code on the WP-1 feature branch worktree wtc-multi-model-orchestration-v1 (paths land on main after WP-1 merges; frozen candidate df463aa6): swarm_orchestration/resource_scope.rs (authorization semantics translated by MT-338, derive_from_sources ~193-228, authorize_row ~781); migrations/0365_worktree_vm_bindings.sql scope pattern (lines 17-21, 38-40); git -c core.longpaths=true invocation discipline mirrored from this WP's MT-141 contract and workspace_safety.rs call-site pattern cited there.
corrections: The gate is verify-only by contract: applying promoted patches to the authoritative repo belongs to the WM merge-back family, not the DW family; the boundary is enforced by grep proof, not convention.
Fail-closed is asymmetric by design: every ambiguous outcome resolves toward 'pending_promotion' or 'denied', never toward 'promoted'; operator recovery is re-running the gate, which is idempotent.

surrealdb_translation_v02_205.schema_rule: Any embedded PostgreSQL DDL/SQL snippet is a semantic field/index/invariant inventory only. Implement it as SCHEMAFULL SurrealQL through SurrealKit; do not execute or mechanically transliterate the snippet.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.concurrency_rule: Translate advisory locks, SKIP LOCKED and row locks into SurrealDB transactions, durable lease/fencing records and conditional updates with equivalent tests.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.notification_rule: Translate LISTEN/NOTIFY into scoped SurrealDB live queries plus bounded resynchronization.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.privacy_rule: Translate RLS into authenticated record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker; administrative credentials cannot prove privacy.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.proof_rule: All named storage proofs run against real SurrealDB. No PostgreSQL process, driver, connection, fixture, environment variable or fallback is permitted.
